findings.reason: the plan must say the strengthened check runs over the post-`write_state` HTML (or reads declarations from the new state), because a node implementing it at the named pre-write site introduces a false refusal on the ordinary additive write that creates a section and ticks it together.
findings.text: §5 says the widened coverage check is "over the resulting plan HTML", yet says the check runs today at the `_write_state_locked` site; that site (reckon/_store.py:1381) runs on `source_text`, the authored text *before* `write_state` injects the new `plan-section-declarations`, so a widened guard reading declarations from the HTML it is handed would test the OLD declarations against the NEW headings — a state write that adds a heading and its declaration in one call (an additive `section_insertions` + `set section_declarations.<id>`) is then falsely refused as `section-without-todo`, which is the additive-write regression §1 exists to prevent
